Players Committee card image of [[Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 aboard Azure Angel. Adds 2 to maneuver of anything he pilots. Players may initiate battles here for free. During battle, your battle destiny draws and Anakin's weapon destiny draws are +1. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/anakinskywalkerpadawanlearner_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 91ca80c] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
